title: Demon and Chained Maiden
description: A blue-skinned horned demon stands behind a blonde woman in a blue and black corset dress, holding her in chains. The scene is filled with hanging wind chimes, spilled paint cans dripping red and blue liquid, white roses, and smoke against a black background.
prompt: A muscular blue demon with large horns stands behind a beautiful blonde woman wearing a blue and black corset dress with red lacing. He holds her by heavy gold chains wrapped around her body. They are surrounded by hanging metal wind chimes, broken paint cans spilling red and blue liquid, white roses, and swirling smoke on a solid black background in a dramatic gothic style.
